title: consolidate-ci-gateways-and-inline-dep-snapshotting
author: Maya Kothari
description:
Motivation: CI sensitivity to transient dependency resolution and a proliferation of small gateway wrappers has increased presubmit latency and made build caches less reproducible. This PR consolidates the CI gateway surface, introduces an inline dependency snapshotter that records resolved transitive pins at presubmit time, and replaces several composite GitHub actions with light-weight, first-class binaries to reduce flakiness and startup overhead.

What I changed: consolidated pkg/ci/gateway* into a single gateway implementation with a pluggable hook for snapshotting; added tools/dep-snapshot (Go) which can emit a deterministic snapshot.json from the resolver used in CI; updated .github/workflows/ci.yaml to call the snapshot tool as an explicit step and to publish the snapshot artifact; removed two composite actions (actions/ci-prepare and actions/deps-collector) and replaced them with direct invocations to tools/dep-snapshot and scripts/presubmit-prober.sh; added Makefile targets for local dev and a minimal shim for the release pipeline to consume snapshots for staged rollouts.

Rollout plan: staged rollout to main CI lanes over 3 days. Step 1: enable snapshot recording on presubmit (this PR). Step 2: enable snapshot validation in the 'fastpath' lane (follow-up toggled by flag). Step 3: set CI to fail on snapshot drift for release branches after one week of telemetry.

Testing done: unit tests for gateway and snapshot logic (pkg/ci/gateway_test.go), e2e smoke in benchmark-lab using a canned resolver fixture, manual local runs using Makefile targets, and CI run with flaky retry reduced to 2.

Compatibility notes: snapshots are additive and do not change runtime model artifacts. Existing releases consume snapshots only if release pipeline flag is enabled. The gateway refactor preserves the public API used by Dedicated/Private installers; I added compatibility shims where necessary.

Checklist:
- [x] Add dep snapshot tool and tests
- [x] Replace composite actions with direct steps in CI
- [x] Preserve gateway public surface with compatibility shims
- [x] Update docs/ci/dep-snapshots.md and onboarding notes
- [x] Add Makefile targets for local dev

References: ENG-4961 for snapshot design; ENG-5870 for CI latency targets.
